metadata.title: Master Services Agreement — Audit Test Globex Corporation

status.note: AI-drafted answer key. A lawyer must read the whole text and confirm every atom and every not_duty before any score from it is named a baseline.

provenance.origin: Dev database, current authoritative version's text snapshot (27715cc5-eb77-4ffd-9491-1f04890ef338).
provenance.wording: Synthetic 'Audit Test' parties created for the October 2026 obligations audit; where the wording came from is not traced. Confirm before this text is committed.
provenance.labelled_by: AI draft (Claude Sonnet 5.5), 2026-10-27, from a full read, the 12 stored rows and the audit's named misses. Not lawyer-confirmed.

names: Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd

atoms.quote: Provider shall perform the services (the "Services") described in one or more statements of work executed by the Parties
Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd shall pay the fees set out in the applicable SOW.
Undisputed invoices are payable within sixty (60) days of receipt.
Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, other than taxes on Provider's income.
atoms.note: Taxes on top of the fees. The audit counted this as a missed duty; a lawyer may reclassify it as an allocation.

atoms.quote: not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice
atoms.note: Cure period a party must allow before terminating for material breach.
Notice Aegis must give before terminating an SOW for convenience.

atoms.quote: paying for Services performed through the termination date
Each Party shall protect the other's Confidential Information with the same care it uses for its own (and no less than reasonable care)
use it only to perform this Agreement
not disclose it except to personnel with a need to know who are bound by confidentiality obligations
grants Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd a perpetual, non-exclusive license to use them as embedded in the deliverables

Provider shall defend, indemnify and hold Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd harmless from third-party claims arising from Provider's breach of this Agreement, its negligence or willful misconduct, or any allegation that a deliverable infringes a third party's intellectual property rights.

Provider shall maintain, at its own expense, commercially reasonable insurance coverage appropriate to the Services, including commercial general liability and professional liability (errors and omissions)
shall provide certificates of insurance on request
may not be assigned by either Party without the other's prior written consent (except to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets)

not_duties.quote: Each SOW is governed by and incorporated into this Agreement; in the event of a conflict, this Agreement controls except where an SOW expressly states otherwise for that SOW.
Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd may withhold payment of amounts it disputes in good faith pending resolution.
This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until terminated.
Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for material breach
or immediately if the other Party becomes insolvent
Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd may terminate any SOW for convenience
Deliverables created for Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd under an SOW are works made for hire and, upon full payment, are owned by Aegis Audit Test Entity Pvt Ltd.
Provider retains ownership of its pre-existing materials and tools

Provider warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with the applicable SOW and generally accepted industry standards, and that the deliverables will not infringe the intellectual property rights of any third party.
neither Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement will exceed the fees paid or payable under the applicable SOW in the six (6) months preceding the claim.
Neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.
It constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties regarding its subject matter
may be amended only in a signed writing
